name: Coverage Build
summary: Agent A's five deterministic skills plus off-site discoverability (the half of the handout that asks why a brand is not found or cited at all) and an opt-in semantic layer. Ships with the model layer off, so the default run is deterministic and needs no API key.

differs_from.A-precision: Adds offsite-discoverability-audit (recommendations only) and sentiment-engagement-audit (inert unless the semantic layer is on). Recommendations ranked by (specificity, effort) and capped at 10, so general advice cannot evict site-specific advice.

llm.guarantee: With the layer off the marketplace performs no LLM call and requires no API key.
